paite: Huchi in Levi chi inkuan a pente siampu Eleaza kiang ah leh Nun tapa Joshua kiang ah leh Israel suante nam inkuan a lupente kiang ah ahoh uhi.
heading: Levite Khopite

paite: "Kanaan gam a Shiloh khua ah, TOUPA'N Mosi zang in ka tenna ding uh khopite, ka gante uh tatna ding akimvel toh na hon piak ding uh thu ana peta," achi uhi.
Huchi in Israel suante'n TOUPA thupiak bang in atantuam ua kipan hiai khopite akimvel toh Levi chite apia uhi.

Aisan Kohath suan tung ah apukta hi. Huchi in siampu Aaron suan Levi chi a mite'n Judah nam tantuam a pan, Simeon nam tantuam a pan leh Benjamin nam tantuam a pan khopi sawm-le-thum aisan in atangta uhi.
Kohath suan dangte'n Ephraim nam suante tantuam a pan, Dan nam tantuam a pan leh Manasseh nam kimkhat tantuam a pan khopi sawm aisan in atangta uhi.
Gershon suante'n Issakar nam suante tantuam a pan, Asher nam tantuam a pan, Naphtali nam tantuam a pan leh Bashan gam a Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan, khopi sawm-le-thum aisan in atangta uhi.
Merari suante'n a-inkuan uh dungzui in Reuben nam tantuam a pan, Gad nam tantuam a pan leh Zebulun nam tantuam a pan khopi sawm-le-nih atangta uhi.
Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi zang a thu apiak bang in Levi mite khopite leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte aisan in apia uhi.
Huchi in Judah suante nam tantuam a pan leh Simeon suante nam tantuam a pan hiai khopi minlohte apia uhi.
Huaite Levi suan Kohath pawl a namte, Aaron suan pawl a ding ahi; amau tung ah aisan apuk masapen hi.
Amau a ding in Judah tanggam a Kiriath-arba leh akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh apia uhi. Kiriath-arba Hebron kichi ahi a, Arba ahihleh Anak pa ahi.
Khopi kimvelte leh akhotate Jephunneh tapa Kaleb tantuam ding in apia uhi.
Siampu Aaron suante Hebron, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Libnah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Jattir khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Eshtemoa khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Holon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Debir khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Ain khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Juttah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Beth-shemesh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; huai nam nihte tantuam a pan khopi kua apia uhi.
Benjamin nam tantuam a pan Gibeon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Geba khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Anathoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Almon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li ape lai uhi.
Aaron suan siampute khopi tengteng khopi sawm-le-thum ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Kohath suante inkuan, Levi pawl leh Kohath suan dangte'n leng atantuam khopite uh Ephraim nam tantuam a pan in ahi atan uh.
Mi that mite kihumbitna khopi Ephraim singtang gam a Shekem khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gezer khua akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Kibzaim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Beth-horon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li apia uhi.
Dan nam tantuam a pan Eltekeh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gibbethon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Aijalon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Gath-rimmon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan Taanak khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Gath-rimmon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi nih.
Kohath suan dangte nam khopi tengteng kho sawm ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.

Gershon suante pawl, Levi namte Manasseh nam kimkhatte tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Bashan gam a Golan khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; Beeshterah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi nih apia uhi.
Issakar nam tantuam a pan Kishion khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Daberath khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Jarmuth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, En-gannim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li.
Asher nam tantuam a pan Mishal khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Helkath khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Rehob khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.

Naphtali nam tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Galili gam a Kadesh khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Hammoth-dor khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kartan khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi thum.
Gershon pawl a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a, atantuam uh khopi tengteng sawm-le-thum ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Merari suante pawl inkuan, Levi pawl dangte bel Zebulun nam tantuam a pan Jokneam khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Kartah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Dimnah khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Nahalal khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, khopi li.
Reuben nam tantuam a pan Bezer khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jahaz khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh,
Kedemoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; khopi li.
Gad nam tantuam a pan, mithat mite kihumbitna khopi, Gilead gam a Ramoth khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Mahanaim khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh;
Heshbon khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh, Jazer khua, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh; avek in khopi li,
Hiai tengteng Levi pawl inkuan dangte Merari suante pawl a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a, akhopite uh ahi. Huchi in atantuam uh khopi sawm-le-nih ahi.
Israel suante pawl tantuam a pan Levi pawl khopi tengteng sawmli-le-giat ahi, akimvel a gantatna ding gamte toh.
Hiai khopite'n akimvel anei chiat ua; khopi tengteng huchibang vek ahi uh.
Huchi in TOUPA'N apipute uh kichiam a piak ana chiamsa gam tengteng Israelte apia hi. Amau huai gam aluah ua, asung ah atengta uhi.
heading: Israel In Gam Aluah

paite: TOUPA'N apipute uh kiang a kichiam a, ana chiamsa bang ngei in mun chih ah muanna apia a, amelma tengteng uh kuamah ama ua pangzou himhim a-om kei uhi. TOUPA'N amelma tengteng akhut uah ape vek hi.
TOUPA'N Israel inkuante kiang a, ahoih lam thu a na gen tengteng vuaksuak khat leng a-om kei a, ahong tung vek hi.
